description: PWGSC, on behalf of Defence Research and Development Canada – Valcartier Research Center, is issuing this Solicitation of offer for the acquisition of Research and Development (R&D) services to develop next-generation C4ISR capabilities to enhance situational awareness and decision-making in multi-domain military operations (land, air, maritime, space, cyber, and information domains). The work will address the integration and exploitation of data from diverse sources using artificial intelligence, machine learning, and multimodal data fusion. Activities will include the development of C4ISR conceptual frameworks, the creation of data integration, analysis, and visualization tools, research into AI-based sensor fusion, the adaptation of analytical capabilities for multi-domain operations, and the assessment of emerging technologies to address future operational requirements. The R&D services are located in Québec, Canada, as detailed in Annex A.

title: Puitejärjestely, murskeiden hankinta 2027-2028
description: Puitejärjestely, murskeiden hankinta 2027-2028 Metsähallitus Metsätalous Oy ja Metsähallitus Luontopalvelut (myöhemmin Metsähallitus) hankkii metsätielle, rakennushankkeisiin sekä purokunnostuksiin murskeita ja kutusoraa joko maa-ainesvarastolta (montulta) tai metsätielle toimitettuna ja levitettynä (sorastuksen palvelukuvaus liite 1). Tarjoaja voi tarjota tarjouksessaan myös myymänsä maa-aineksen kuljetusta, jolloin hän tarjoaa kertoimen suhteessa sorastuksen taksataulukkoon (liite 2). Tarjoaja voi tarjouksessaan kieltäytyä myymästä maa-aineksia muutoin kuin tielle toimitettuna. Tarjouksessa tulee ilmoittaa maa-ainespaikan sijainti ja tarjottavat murskeet hintoineen varastolla. Tarjousten perusteella Metsähallitus hyväksyy toimittajat puitejärjestelyyn. Puitejärjestely alkaa 1.1.2027 ja päättyy 31.12.2028. Tarjottuihin hintoihin sovelletaan liitteen 5 mukaista indeksiehtoa. Sekä tarjottu murskeen hinta että kuljetuksen maksukerroin nousee tai laskee indeksiehdon mukaisesti. Kuhunkin käyttökohteeseen Metsähallitus vertailee puitejärjestelyyn hyväksyttyjen tarjoajien maa-ainespaikkojen sijaintia, tarjontaa ja hintoja. Murske hankitaan kokonaiskustannukseltaan edullisimmalta tarjoajalta. Murskeen monttuhintaan lisätään tällöin kuljetuskustannus murskeen myyjän tai Metsähallituksen sopimuskumppanin kalustolla. Ennen tilausta tai sopimusta tilaaja selvittää saatavuuden tarjoajan yhteyshenkilöltä. Metsähallitus pidättää oikeuden käyttää omia murskeitaan riippumatta puitejärjestelyyn hyväksytyistä tarjouksista. Metsähallitus pidättää myös oikeuden hankkia murskeita muilta toimittajilta, mikäli puitejärjestelyyn hyväksytyiltä maa-ainespaikoilta ei löydy tarvittavaa mursketta kohtuulliselta etäisyydeltä (alle 20 km). Metsähallituksen hallinnoimien alueiden sijainti on esitetty www.retkikartta.fi. Valitse Karttatasot - Metsätalouden monikäyttömetsät - Suojelu- ja retkeilyalueet sekä sopiva taustakartta. Mikäli yksittäisen hankinnan arvo ylittää kansallisen kynnysarvon (60 000 €), siitä laaditaan sopimus (liite 3a). Mikäli yksittäisen hankinnan arvo ylittää EU-kynnysarvon (1.1.2026 alkaen 216 000 €), toimittajan tulee toimittaa rikosrekisteriotteet. Kynnysarvoja pienemmistä hankinnoista Metsähallitus laatii tilauksen (ks. liitteet 3c ja 3d).,

title: Kodinkoneet 2027-2029 Mikalo Oy, Mikkelin asumisoikeus Oy
description: Kodinkoneet 2027-2029 Mikalo Oy, Mikkelin asumisoikeus Oy Mikalo Oy ja Mikkelin Asumisoikeus Oy kilpailuttavat yhdessä kodinkonehankinnat. Hankinnan kohteena on kylmäkoneita, lattialiesiä sekä mikroaaltouuneja. Sopimuskausi on 3 vuotta, ja tilaaja varaa oikeuden hyödyntää kahden (2) vuoden optiokauden. Kaikki laitteet hankitaan kokonaispalveluna asennettuina, ja tarjotun laitehinnan on aina sisällettävä kuljetus, kerroksiinkanto, asennus käyttövalmiiksi, sähkö- tai liitäntätyöt sekä vanhan laitteen poiskuljetus ja kierrätys. Hankinnan laajuus, rajaukset ja sopimuskauden aikaiset muutokset: 1. Mikkelin kaupungin kohteiden rajaus (Ehdollinen optio): Kilpailutuksen tuloksena syntyvää puitejärjestelyä voivat hyödyntää Mikalo Oy:n ja Mikkelin Asumisoikeus Oy:n lisäksi myös Mikkelin kaupunki. Kaupungin osalta sopimus rajataan koskemaan ainoastaan niitä Mikkelin kaupungin omistuksessa olevia vuokra-asuntoja, joita Mikalo Oy isännöi tai ylläpitää. Sopimus ei koske kaupungin muita toimitiloja, virastoja tai laitoksia. Hankintayksikkö pidättää oikeuden laajentaa tilauksia koskemaan näitä kaupungin vuokra-asuntoja, mikäli/jos kyseisiä asuntokantoja siirtyy sopimuskauden aikana suoraan Mikalon hallintaan tai omistukseen. Mikkelin kaupungin osalta tarve koskee satunnaisia ja vähäisiä kodinkonehankintoja sopimuskauden aikana. 2. Uudisrakentaminen, peruskorjaukset ja suurten erien toimitusehdot: Tätä puitesopimusta voidaan hyödyntää vuokrataloyhtiöiden juoksevien arjen korvaushankintojen lisäksi myös hankintayksiköiden omissa uudisrakennus- ja peruskorjauskohteissa (esim. linjasaneeraukset ja perusparannukset). Suurissa peruskorjaus- ja uudiskohteissa, joissa laitteita tilataan kerralla yhteen osoitteeseen yli kymmenen (10) kappaletta, toimitusaika ja logistiikka sovitaan erikseen tapauskohtaisesti hankintayksikön ja toimittajan kesken rakennustyömaan aikataulun mukaan. Mikäli laitteet tilataan peruskorjaus- tai uudiskohteeseen (työmaalle) pelkästään toimitettuna ilman asennusta, tilaaja pyytää toimittajalta tapauskohtaisesti erillisen hyvityksen/alennuksen asennustyön ja vanhan laitteen kierrätyksen osuudesta.,

title: Impregnert trevirke - Transport og mottak
description: Bakgrunn Sirkula IKS (Sirkula), Renovasjonsselskapet GLØR IKS (GLØR), Midt-Gudbrandsdal Renovasjonsselskap (MGR) og Hadeland og Ringerike Avfallsselskap AS (HRA) har behov for å inngå en ny rammeavtale for transport og mottak av impregnert trevirke, ettersom eksisterende avtale utløper. Ny avtale skal gjelde fra 02.02.2027. Konkurransen gjennomføres av innkjøpssamarbeidet Innsikt Innkjøp på vegne av oppdragsgiverne. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder inngåelse av en rammeavtale for transport og mottak av impregnert trevirke for Sirkula, GLØR, MGR og HRA. Leveransen omfatter henting av impregnert trevirke fra oppdragsgivernes anlegg, transport til godkjent mottaks- eller forbrenningsanlegg samt behandling av avfallet. Rammeavtalen skal dekke oppdragsgivernes løpende behov i avtaleperioden. Omfanget varierer mellom selskapene, og hentefrekvensen vil derfor være behovsstyrt gjennom avrop. Estimerte årlige mengder er: Sirkula: 1 500 tonn GLØR: 1 200 tonn HRA: 1 400 tonn MGR: 400 tonn Estimert verdi, basert på forventet forbruk for alle delkontrakter samlet, er 12,3 MNOK. Maksimal verdi for alle delkontrakter samlet er 23 MNOK. Bakgrunnen for dette er at mengden impregnert trevirke oppdragsgiverne mottar i løpet av kontraktsperioden, kan være vanskelig å forutse. Om drivstoff For delkontraktene til Sirkula, GLØR og HRA vil bruk av nullutslipp og/eller biogass inngå i evalueringen under tildelingskriteriet miljø. For delkontrakten til HRA stilles det et absolutt krav om bruk av nullutslipp og/eller biogass. Dette er begrunnet i geografisk lokalisering og selskapsinterne vurderinger.

description: BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to bid solicitations is soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca. Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808. The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. REQUIREMENT The Parks Canada Agency (PCA) has a requirement for qualified Contractor to dismantle the northwest (NW) bastion structure at Fort Langley National Historic Site (FLNHS) and purchase new timbers for future reconstruction. Bidders who do not participate in the visit will not be precluded from submitting a bid. Any clarifications or changes to the bid solicitation resulting from the site visit will be included as an amendment to the bid solicitation. title: Belgium – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Purchase, delivery, installation and commissioning of a multi-wavelength orthogonal tomographic volumetric 3D printing system
description: This contract concerns the purchase, delivery, installation, commissioning and handover of a fully operational multi-wavelength orthogonal tomographic volumetric 3D printing system for scientific research. Explanation: The infrastructure is intended for advanced research in tomographic volumetric 3D printing, in which multiple optical wavelengths can be controlled independently to achieve spatial control over different photochemical processes. The system must enable research into multi-wavelength and multi-material tomographic 3D printing. The contract comprises a complete and fully integrated system, including all optical, mechanical and electronic components, light sources, control hardware and software, safety equipment and accessories required for its intended operation. The contract includes delivery of the complete system and all required accessories; installation and commissioning at Ghent University; system configuration, calibration and functional verification; provision of the necessary control and processing software; user training; user and technical documentation; and technical support, warranty and maintenance as further specified in the tender specifications.

title: Netherlands – Sanitary paper products – SARO Europese aanbesteding sanitaire voorzieningen 2026
description: Deze Offerteaanvraag betreft de Europese openbare Aanbesteding Sanitaire voorzieningen waarop de meest recente versie van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 (Aw-2012) van toepassing is. De aanbesteding heeft betrekking op het leveren, beheren, onderhouden en vervangen van sanitaire voorzieningen ten behoeve van Stichting Samen Ambitieus Rotterdams Onderwijs (SARO), hierna tenoemen de Aanbestedende dienst of Opdrachtgever. De geraamde waarde van deze opdracht bedraagt circa € 3 miljoen exclusief btw, inclusief de maximale looptijd van de overeenkomst en alle verlengingsopties. Deze raming is gebaseerd op historische uitgaven van SARO, de huidige omvang van de organisatie, de verwachte gefaseerde instroom van locaties en de uitgangspunten van deze aanbesteding. De raming is indicatief en kan tot ±30% afwijken als gevolg van wijzigingen in locaties, leerling- en medewerkers aantallen, gebruiksintensiteit of andere relevante omstandigheden. Aan deze raming kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend.

title: Angler Mine Neutralization Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) Systems and Support
description: Description This presolicitation notice is published to announce that Direct Reporting Program Manager for Robotic and Autonomous Systems (DRPM RAS) intends to award a Firm Fixed Price sole-source contract to Advanced Acoustic Concepts, LLC (AAC), 425 Oser Avenue, Hauppauge, NY 11788 (CAGE: 4GPS8) for the procurement of Angler Mine Neutralization Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) Systems, operator consoles, reload kits, depot-level testing, spares, peculiar support equipment, and associated technical, logistics, and software engineering services. This requirement will be negotiated on a sole-source basis in accordance with statutory authority 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.103-1 (RFO) (Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements). The system was matured across prior competitive Office of Naval Research (ONR) Science & Technology (S&T) contracts N00014-18-C-1027 and N00014-21-C-1006, and initial low-rate operational fielding under N66604-24-D-C401. AAC is the original designer, developer, systems integrator, and sole manufacturer of the Angler platform. The Government does not possess a complete, validated Technical Data Package (TDP) suitable for competition production, integration, qualification, and safety certification of the existing Angler configuration. Specifically, the Government has only Limited and Restricted Rights to the core system architecture, including the deep-water 20mm standoff projectile design, gun subsystem, and the proprietary Navigation and Control (NAC) software suite. Award to any other source would result in a substantial duplication of cost to the Government not expected to be recovered through competition and would cause unacceptable developmental and safety-certification delays. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. However, all responsible sources may submit a capability statement, which shall be considered by the agency. Interested sources shall identify their capability to satisfy the requirement; relevant technical, production, integration, and support experience; and any material assumptions, Government-furnished information, technical-data rights, software rights, interfaces, qualification activities, or transition period necessary to perform. Responses shall be submitted by 1000 on 24 November 2026 to the contacts listed in this posting.

title: Weapons Effects Solicitation
description: This solicitation is related to Notice IDs: N00167-25-RFP-CD-66-001 and N00167-25-RFP-CD-66-001_Rev1. The contractor shall provide scientific and technical services with experts in UNDEX and AIREX analysis of undersea and surface vessels to develop and utilize specialized software codes that: 1) Aid in the selection of live fire events and provide support to live fire test and evaluation programs; 2) Simulate an underwater shock environment from a far field or near miss location; 3) Simulate the response of Navy platforms to UNDEX and AIREX for far field, near miss, contact, and internally detonating weapon attacks; 4) Check the integrity of computational models; 5) Solve finite element models elastic-plastic response and reduced order engineering tools to UNDEX and AIREX events; and 6) Simulate a nuclear underwater shock environment or nuclear air blast environment from a far field location. This opportunity is for SEAPORT-NxG MAC HOLDERS ONLY- UNRESTRICTED. No other offers will be considered. Proposals submitted by non-MAC holders will not be evaluated. Please note the Navy has transitioned from the legacy SeaPort portal to the PIEE Solicitation Module for the submission of offers, proposals, and awards under SeaPort-NxG. SeaPort MAC holders will need to register for PIEE accounts in order to receive solicitations and submit proposals/offers. Please reference the official Department of Defense registration guide for vendors on how to set up accounts in PIEE:https://www.acq.osd.mil/asda/dpc/ce/cap/docs/piee/PIEE_Solicitation_Module_Vendor_Access_Instructions.pdf. Provision L-215-H006 (c) states that all questions shall be submitted via email to the Primary and Secondary Solicitation Managers identified in the Solicitation Module HOWEVER all questions shall be submitted via the PIEE Solicitation Module Question and Answer Function. Responses will be posted within the PIEE Solicitation Module. The solicitation will be amended to reflect the correct submission procedures for questions. *Manual upload to Contract Opportunities in SAM.gov as all previous attempts to post failed*

title: Intraoperative Neuromonitoring Services
description: Action: Notice of Intent to Award a Sole Source Bridge Contract Agency/Contracting Activity: Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA) Health Contracting Division-Falls Church (HCD-FC) NAICS Code: 621111 / PSC: Q510 Subject: Sole Source Bridge Contract for Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) Services for Dwight D. Eisenhower Army Medical Center (EAMC) Solicitation Number: HT0014-27-Q-E015 Closing Response Date: November 24, 2026, 10:00 AM EST Point of Contact: Sherina Ross, Contract Specialist, Email: sherina.l.ross.civ@health.mil and Sara Fetterolf, Contracting Officer, Email: sara.fetterolf.civ@health.mil 1. Description of Requirement The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity Healthcare Contracting Division � Falls Church (HCD-FC) intends to award a firm-fixed-price, sole-source bridge contract to Risen Video Production, LLC, a Small Business concern. This action is a logical follow-on to contract W91YTZ21C0010. The requirement is for the continued provision of on-site Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) services for the Department of Surgery at Dwight D. Eisenhower Army Medical Center Fort Gordon, Georgia. The estimated value of the three-month bridge period is $62,195.25, with a period of performance from December 7, 2026, through March 6, 2027. 2. Authority and Justification The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition for this requirement under the Simplified Acquisition Threshold utilizing the authority of Title 41 U.S.C. �1901(e)(2) as implemented in Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) FAR 12.102 (a): For acquisitions valued at or below the simplified acquisition threshold (SAT), which authorizes contracting without full and open competition when the services required are available from only one responsible source, and the continued provision of highly specialized services would result in unacceptable delays in fulfilling the agency's requirements. The justification for this sole-source bridge action is as follows: Urgent Need for Continuity of Service: The current contract, W91YTZ21C0010, is expiring on December 6, 2026. Due to acquisition workforce challenges and insufficient procurement lead time resulting from an unsuccessful solicitation to establish a competitive long-term follow-on under the Medical Q-Coded Support and Services Next Generation (MQS2-NG) vehicle (TOPR 10726) which yielded no viable awardee. Additionally, the requirement transitioned inter-regionally from DHA Southeast to DHA Falls Church on November 1, 2026. Due to these issues there is not sufficient time to resolicit a full and open competition for the follow-on requirement without a lapse in service. 3. Submission of Information This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. However, the Government will consider all capability statements received by the closing date of this notice from responsible sources who believe they can meet the requirement without causing a lapse in critical surgical services. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract action based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be used only for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement for this bridge requirement or to proceed with the bridge while finalizing the competitive 5-year follow-on procurement. Please submit any capability statements electronically to the Point of Contact, Sherina Ross, Email: sherina.l.ross.civ@health.mil.

title: Weapons Effect Solicitation
description: This solicitation is related to Notice IDs: N00167-25-RFP-CD-66-0014 and N00167-25-RFP-CD-66-0014_Rev1. The contractor shall provide scientific and technical services with experts in UNDEX and AIREX analysis of undersea and surface vessels to develop and utilize specialized software codes that: 1) Aid in the selection of live fire events and provide support to live fire test and evaluation programs; 2) Simulate an underwater shock environment from a far field or near miss location; 3) Simulate the response of Navy platforms to UNDEX and AIREX for far field, near miss, contact, and internally detonating weapon attacks; 4) Check the integrity of computational models; 5) Solve finite element models elastic-plastic response and reduced order engineering tools to UNDEX and AIREX events; and 6) Simulate a nuclear underwater shock environment or nuclear air blast environment from a far field location. This opportunity is for SEAPORT-NxG MAC HOLDERS ONLY- UNRESTRICTED. No other offers will be considered. Proposals submitted by non-MAC holders will not be evaluated. Please note the Navy has transitioned from the legacy SeaPort portal to the PIEE Solicitation Module for the submission of offers, proposals, and awards under SeaPort-NxG. SeaPort MAC holders will need to register for PIEE accounts in order to receive solicitations and submit proposals/offers. Please reference the official Department of Defense registration guide for vendors on how to set up accounts in PIEE:https://www.acq.osd.mil/asda/dpc/ce/cap/docs/piee/PIEE_Solicitation_Module_Vendor_Access_Instructions.pdf.Provision L-215-H006 (c) states that all questions shall be submitted via email to the Primary and Secondary Solicitation Managers identified in the Solicitation Module HOWEVER all questions shall be submitted via the PIEE Solicitation Module Question and Answer Function. Responses will be posted within the PIEE Solicitation Module. The solicitation will be amended to reflect the correct submission procedures for questions. See Amendment 0001, effective 21 Oct 26.

title: Y1AA--890CM3013 Design Build (DB) Services for Renovation of Renovation of Historic Lodge/Administration Building at Fort McPherson National Cemetery
description: 11/17/2024 Due date for capability statement is Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 10:00 am EST to Richard Adu at Richard.Adu@va.gov. Solicitation Number: 36C78627R0010 Project Number: 890CM3013 Description: Design Build (DB) Services for Renovation of Historic Lodge/Administration Building at Fort McPherson National Cemetery The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), National Cemetery Administration (NCA) Central District is currently seeking firms with the ability to provide Design Build (DB) Services for Renovation of Historic Lodge/Administration Building at Fort McPherson National Cemetery Statement of Work: The purpose of this project is to provide design and construction for the renovation of the historic Fort McPherson National Cemetery Lodge Building, located at 12004 S Spur 56A Maxwell, NE 69151-1166. The design goal is to be respectful of the original designs developed by the office of the Quartermaster General of the Army, Montgomery C. Meigs, while allowing the updated use of the lodge as modern and efficient office space. The Fort McPherson Cemetery remains active, and visitation occurs regularly. The bulk of public interaction occurs at the historic Lodge/Administration building and there is need to accommodate visitors other than staff and NCA personnel. Barrier-free accessible visitor restrooms are provided in an adjacent building. The proposed interventions will respect the historic character of the lodge, and its regional variations, while providing enhanced occupant and visitor experience. Accommodations for barrier-free access must be integrated in a discreet fashion and not adversely impact the overall perception of the historic character of the lodges. Finally. proposed treatments must meet a 50-year life cycle performance goal, under regular routine maintenance conditions. Although proposed building systems may be residential in scale, they should meet energy efficiency standards. The Design Build (DB) Contractor shall provide Architectural and Engineering disciplines for the preparation of construction documents for the purpose of completing the construction project. The DB Contractor shall be responsible for the quality, accuracy and completeness of the documents required to complete the SOW. Requirements contained herein are minimums; each discipline performing engineering services for this contract shall meet current industry standards for the content and quality of deliverables. The D/B Contractor shall be responsible for coordinating the documents and for producing a complete set of construction documents in accordance with professional practices. Complete and accurate coordination between the disciplines and quality control of all consultants work shall be required. All drawings require a professional license seal and signature by the discipline responsible for the work. The D/B Contractor shall be responsible for ensuring that the quality of construction and materials complies with the Construction Documents reviewed and accepted by the Government. PROJECT SCOPE AND DESIGN CRITERIA (Survey, design, engineering, and construction contract is to include all design, engineering services, and construction associated with items 7.1 through 7.5). 7.1. The Secretary of the Interior Standards for Restoration and the Standards for Rehabilitation will be applied to the building envelope and primary interior spaces as follows: 7.1.1. Restoration of exterior brick and stone masonry. Additional survey of the exterior masonry was conducted by Schnabel Conservation, Masonry Conservator. The updated findings (Appendix A) inform the proposed scope of Work. 7.1.2. New slate roofing, sheet metal roofing, and associated copper flashing and gutter lining. 7.1.3. New wood windows and doors matching the original in design and meeting contemporary performance standards. 7.1.4. Remodeling of enclosed porch to provide a conditioned space, with the new wood frame and railing concealing the fame of the glazed storefront assembly beyond. This will include new, period appropriate wood stairs and railing. 7.1.5. New period appropriate interior wood doors, and new interior wood trim at windows, doors and wall base, typical first and second floors. 7.1.6. Refinishing of existing wood flooring at first and second floors. 7.1.7. New built-in window seats/storage at second floor windows. 7.1.8. New period appropriate mantel at primary first floor office. 7.1.9. New period appropriate light fixtures at porch, and first floor main office. 7.2. The Secretary of the Interior Standards for Rehabilitation will be applied to secondary and tertiary spaces, as follows: 7.2.1. Barrier-free access at the main entrance with the incorporation of FlexStep by LiftUp, a 2-in-1 stairlift and steps solution which can be configured as a flight of stairs, and then be transformed into a platform lift on an as-needed basis. (Product data follows this section). 7.2.2. New telecom room in basement. 7.2.3. New secure storage room and remodeling of break room/kitchen at first floor. 7.2.4. New bathroom at second floor. 7.2.5. New HVAC equipment and duct chases and soffits at second floor. 7.2.6. New electrical conduits and It/telecom outlets for workstations. 7.3. Contractor furnished, installed, and commissioning of a temporary staff trailer to support cemetery operations during construction. Contractor must support relocation of staff and potentially the Gravesite Locator during construction, and as follows: 7.3.1 The Contractor shall provide delegated design, delivery, installation, utility connection, and commissioning of a temporary occupied trailer facility for use by cemetery staff. Requirements must follow the Architectural Barriers Act (ABA) Standards and all applicable state/local codes. 7.3.2. Trailer modules must be fully skirted with treated wood framing, ventilation, and access panels for sanitary tank servicing. 7.3.3. Provide centralized heating & cooling maintaining 70 80°F, humidity at 50% (AC season). Provide appropriate HVAC units (e.g., Bard wall-mounted units with heat strips) and dedicated split system for telecom equipment. Provide restroom exhaust fans and insulated ductwork. 7.3.4. Provide temporary power connection, including new service meter/disconnect if required. Electrical requirements to be identified by Contractor and coordinated with VA. 7.3.5. Provide power/data for a minimum of three (3) staff workstations and GovernmentFurnished Gravesite Locator (GSL) kiosk installation at the trailer. Breakroom/kitchenette and restroom required in the staff trailer. 7.3.6. Additional admin trailer locations may require survey, grading, utility tie-ins, geotechnical work, and civil design depending on final location. 7.4. New Backup Power Generator: Contractor furnished, installed and commissioned new power generator and fuel storage to provide 72 hour backup power supply for all buildings in the Maintenance and Administration Building complex. At a minimum the generator will provide backup power for the Historic Lodge/Administration Building, Public Restrooms, and Maintenance Building. 7.5 Furniture, Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) Bid Package: The FF&E scope includes planning, specification, procurement support, delivery, installation, and commissioning. Assemble Issue-for-Bid (IFB) documents for the Government: itemized schedules, cut sheets, performance criteria, warranty terms, installation requirements, services (delivery, staging, assembly, anchoring, protection), and phasing plans aligned to VA and construction contract procedures. All services performed by the contractor must adhere to National Cemetery Administration standards. Period of Performance The Contractor shall complete all work including submittals, reviews, quality control, repair/construction services, punch list corrections, clean up, invoicing and closeouts documentation submittal within five hundred and forty (540) calendar days from Government issuance of the Notice to Proceed. title: Weapons Effect Solicitation
description: This solicitation is related to Notice IDs: N00167-25-RFP-CD-66-001 and N00167-25-RFP-CD-66-001_Rev1. The contractor shall provide scientific and technical services with experts in UNDEX and AIREX analysis of undersea and surface vessels to develop and utilize specialized software codes that: 1) Aid in the selection of live fire events and provide support to live fire test and evaluation programs; 2) Simulate an underwater shock environment from a far field or near miss location; 3) Simulate the response of Navy platforms to UNDEX and AIREX for far field, near miss, contact, and internally detonating weapon attacks; 4) Check the integrity of computational models; 5) Solve finite element models elastic-plastic response and reduced order engineering tools to UNDEX and AIREX events; and 6) Simulate a nuclear underwater shock environment or nuclear air blast environment from a far field location. This opportunity is for SEAPORT-NxG MAC HOLDERS ONLY- UNRESTRICTED. No other offers will be considered. Proposals submitted by non-MAC holders will not be evaluated. Please note the Navy has transitioned from the legacy SeaPort portal to the PIEE Solicitation Module for the submission of offers, proposals, and awards under SeaPort-NxG. SeaPort MAC holders will need to register for PIEE accounts in order to receive solicitations and submit proposals/offers. Please reference the official Department of Defense registration guide for vendors on how to set up accounts in PIEE:https://www.acq.osd.mil/asda/dpc/ce/cap/docs/piee/PIEE_Solicitation_Module_Vendor_Access_Instructions.pdf.Provision L-215-H006 (c) states that all questions shall be submitted via email to the Primary and Secondary Solicitation Managers identified in the Solicitation Module HOWEVER all questions shall be submitted via the PIEE Solicitation Module Question and Answer Function. Responses will be posted within the PIEE Solicitation Module. The solicitation will be amended to reflect the correct submission procedures for questions. See Amendment 0001, effective 21 Oct 26.
